profile.name: erica huang
profile.bio: hi! i'm erica. i make websites that engage audiences visually and perform at scale. i work with designers, engineers, and marketers to turn ideas into useful products. i also make games and other cool things sometimes too.
profile.askMeAbout: ask me about my projects, work, or my love for toro inuoue!

projects.name: clubhouse
projects.tagline: a website for students to rate and review clubs at ucla.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: UCLA students lacked a centralized, transparent way to discover and evaluate student organizations before committing their time.

Action: As lead developer, I led end-to-end development across the stack, including APIs, authentication, deployment, and core review features. As product manager, I work closely with design, engineering, and marketing teams to ship iteratively and build user-centric features.

Outcome: Launched a scalable platform used by UCLA students to browse, rate, and review clubs. Recently launched 2 new features, `User Profiles' and `Club Recommendations'.

projects.name: ucla student affairs
projects.tagline: accessibility-focused web development for ucla student affairs sites.
projects.details:
Details:

Develop and maintain UCLA websites serving 14M+ annual page views. Key projects include migrating major university sites to component-based architecture, creating custom web components, and building an open graph image rendering pipeline.

projects.name: michael dean wilkins
projects.tagline: a freelance portfolio site for an la-based photographer.
projects.details:
Details:

Problem: A photographer needed a visually appealling, performant portfolio with easy content management.

Action: I designed and built the site with a headless CMS, focusing on performance, responsive layout, and a modern visual identity.

Outcome: Successfully deployed a photography portfolio site that client can maintain with a simple content workflow.

Details:

Details:
